summary: Agnico Eagle Mines filed a Form 6-K attaching a press release announcing a C$22.4M private placement investment in Wallbridge Mining. Agnico Eagle agreed to purchase 243.9 million common shares at C$0.092/share. Post-closing, Agnico Eagle will own ~19.62% (non-diluted) and will enter an investor rights agreement granting participation rights and board nomination rights. The transaction is a strategic minority equity investment, not a controlling acquisition. The filing is a foreign private issuer report of a material event, not a special-situation M&A deal. Close expected on or about May 22, 2026, subject to TSX approval.
